record.title: Evaluate application liveness and the exact next bench intervention
record.intent: Stop transport guesswork and locate the smallest justified physical continuation.
requirements: Distinguish successful application identity response from ADB service health and native epoch acceptance. Record available current UI witness or its absence. State what remains unknown and whether an additional normal reboot or specimen daemon action would be required; do not exercise an unadmitted state change.

Commit and push the conclusion before further experiment admission. Preserve the frozen A1/B/A2 RF hypothesis and deadline. No liveness result waives the epoch gate or permits adding RF records, an ambiguous retry, extra reboot, persistent ADB setting change or speculative firmware action.
acceptance: A reasoned diagnostic result and precise next bench question replace further blind reconnect attempts.
